meta.title: Lenox Iresitora-Akabare Gitega | Inzu y'ibirori y'abantu 800, iresitora n'akabare
meta.description: Iresitora, akabare n'inzu y'ibirori y'abantu 800 i Gitega, mu mudugudu wa NYABIHARAGE. Ibifungurwa vy'iburaya n'ivy'isi, umuziki uba ubonetse, ubwikinge bw'imodoka 50, umutekano 24/24.

hero.title: Ameza n'inzu bitera imigambi myiza i Gitega
hero.lead: Ahantu hehezagiye ku birori vyanyu n'ibonekerwa. Ibifungurwa vy'umuhemu, ibinyobwa vyatoroshe, ibidukikije vyiza.
hero.proof: Abashitsi 800+ · Aho kuhagarika imodoka 50+ · Umutekano 24/24 · Wi-Fi y'ubuntu

about.title: Ivyerekeye Lenox
about.lead: Lenox Iresitora-Akabare ni ho uhurira mu gisagara ca Gitega ku bushikiro bwiza bw'ibifungurwa n'ibibihe bitaryozwa.
about.story_p1: Iri hantu ryatewe mu mutima wa Gitega mu mudugudu wa NYABIHARAGE, Lenox Iresitora-Akabare ni ico gisenge gikomatanyije imico n'igihe gishasha. Twiyemeje gutanga ubushikiro bw'ibifungurwa budasanzwe mu bidukikije vy'ubumwe n'ubushikiro.
about.story_p2: Itsinda ryacu ry'abakozi b'umutima rikora buri musi kugira ritange ibifungurwa vy'umuhemu, ibinyobwa vyiza, na serivisi nziza ku birori vyanyu vyose.

highlights.cuisine_body: Ibitangira umunsi, amafunguro y'amanywa n'ary'ijoro vy'umuhemu bifise ibikoresho vyo mu karere n'ivy'isi yose.
highlights.shows_body: Umuziki uba ubonetse, karaoke, n'ibikorwa vy'amatsinda kugira bishimishe ubwire bwanyu bw'ijoro.
highlights.events_body: Inzu y'ibirori y'abantu 800+, ikwiye kubera ubukwe n'amanama.
highlights.wifi_body: Interineti y'umuvuduko munini iboneka ku bashitsi bose.

services.title: Serivisi zacu
services.lead: Raba interuro yose y'ibikorwa dutanga kugira igihe cose kibe ico kidukikije neza.

restaurant.title: Iresitora
restaurant.body: Ibitangira umunsi, amafunguro y'amanywa n'ary'ijoro vy'umuhemu bifise ibikoresho vyo mu karere n'ivy'isi yose.

bar.title: Akabare
bar.body: Ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibinyobwa birimwo ivya Brarudi, ibinyobwa vy'isi yose, divayi, shampanye n'ivya cocktail.

shows.title: Uburyohe bw'umuziki
shows.body: Umuziki uba ubonetse, karaoke, ibikorwa vy'amatsinda n'ibidukikije vya night club kugura ijoro ryanyu.

hall.title: Inzu y'ibirori
hall.body: Ahantu hashobora kwakira abantu 800+ ku birori vyanyu, ubukwe, amanama n'inyigisho.

parking.title: Ubwikinge bw'imodoka
parking.body: Ubwikinge bw'imodoka bwiza bwizewe bushobora kwakira imodoka 50+ ku gukwegera kw'abakiliya bacu.

security.title: Umutekano
security.body: Umutekano w'urugero rwo hejuru kugira utange umutekano w'imitima ku bashitsi mu birori vyose.

menu.title: Urutonde rw'ibifungurwa
menu.lead: Ihitamwo ry'ibifungurwa vyacu vy'umuhemu. Urutonde rwuzuye ruboneka aho.
menu.note: Ibiciro vyerekanwa mu mafaranga y'uburundi, serivisi irimwo.
menu.items: «gusubiriza: izina, ivyo bisobanuro bicye, igiciro ku bifungurwa 6 kugeza 9»

events.title: Ibirori vyanyu
events.lead: Ubukwe, amanama, inyigisho: inzu y'abantu 800, ubwikinge bw'imodoka 50, itsinda rishobora vyose.
events.wedding_body: Inzu itunganyije mu buryo bwa banquet, serivisi y'ibifungurwa, sisitemu y'ijwi na Lenox Live Band.
events.conference_body: Iterambere rya theatre, Wi-Fi y'umuvuduko, akaruhuko k'ikawa n'amafunguro aho.
events.corporate_body: Cocktail y'ijoro, akabare kuzuye, uburyohe n'umutekano wihariye.

gallery.title: Amafoto
gallery.lead: Raba ahantu hacu heza, ibifungurwa vyacu vy'umuhemu n'ibidukikije vyihariye bituma Lenox ariho hatangaje.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.lead: Tur hano kugira tugufashe gutegura ibirori vyanyu no gusubiza ibibazo vyanyu vyose.
contact.whatsapp_prefill: Muraho Lenox, nshaka kubona amakuru kuri

form.title: Tungikira ubutumwa
form.success_body: Murakoze. Itsinda ryacu rizogusubiza mu masaha 24. Ku bikenewe vyunama, hamagara +257 65 186 498.
form.error: Kurungika vyankiwe. Gerageza canke utuhamagare ubwawe.
